- [USER] User asked when Florence Griffith-Joyner set the world record.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Florence Griffith-Joyner set the current world record for the women's 100-meter sprint on July 16, 1988, at the U.S. Olympic Trials in Indianapolis, Indiana.
